top_choice_rationale: P001 credits a complete, independently confirmed discovery arc (proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) amide, human incretin physiology, receptor mechanism) with large outcome-trial benefit in diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular and renal disease. The physiology-led citation names the therapeutic consequence without claiming the drug engineering. Residual weaknesses are the omission of Knudsen and the unresolved Mojsov versus Habener priority question, but neither outweighs the maturity and merit of the achievement, so an award is preferred to no award.
